summary: Compared the source snapshot and exact 1920 px reference/render/diff crops for product-inquiry-overview. The wrapper geometry passes (x delta -2 px), but the visible product information, pricing controls, typography and spacing materially diverge; diagnostic crop mismatch is 14.561%.
issues:
PI-OVERVIEW-001 | critical | native product markup/content: expected product code and producer on separate clean lines; actual visibly prints the literal '
' after product code. Fix escaping/rendering of the editable product metadata.

PI-OVERVIEW-002 | critical | price: expected promotional 5 L price 411,00 zł, crossed-out 530,00 zł, '(w tym 23% VAT)' and lowest-price note; actual shows a broad 82,20 zł–1.644,00 zł range and omits the promotional/previous-price/VAT/lowest-price presentation. Render the selected native 5 L variation and source-backed promotional fields shown by the reference.

PI-OVERVIEW-003 | high | variation/cart controls: expected bordered quantity stepper, green cart button with cart icon, three 1 L/5 L/20 L pills with 5 L active, and orange 'Zamienniki' control; actual controls are collapsed/misaligned, use a purple cart button, and show an unrelated orange inquiry-price notice. Rebuild the native variation and cart control presentation to the source geometry and styling.

PI-OVERVIEW-004 | high | typography/spacing: expected bold 48 px-scale title and structured vertical rhythm; actual title is lighter/smaller and the controls leave a large empty region before the inquiry dialog. Match source typography and subnode placement within the otherwise correctly sized wrapper.
